title: kinematic_sketch.json
description: The kinematic sketch of the reference unit as it was photographed: exactly the 33 quantities of Appendix D of the brief, each with a nominal value, a tolerance and its sources.

kingpin_ground_offset_mm.description: King-pin offset at the ground of a front wheel. The king-pin axis is the line through the centres of the upper and the lower ball joint of the steering knuckle. source_id.description: A source id. It names one given document or picture: B-01 to B-16 (items of brief.md), BL-01 to BL-10 (entries of build_log.md), PH-01 to PH-33 (photographs), DS-.. (datasheet pages), ER-. (erratum notices), LR-. (lot reports). Only an id that exists is accepted.

sources.description: The source ids of the places where the value can be read: at most 16.
